ARC-001-EVAL-v1.0.title: Vendor Evaluation Criteria: Exchange Online Migration to Microsoft 365

controlFields.MQ-001: Microsoft Gold/Solutions Partner for Modern Work (Cloud Productivity competency)
controlFields.MQ-002: Minimum 5 years experience delivering Exchange Online migrations
controlFields.MQ-003: Minimum 3 UK Government/Public Sector migration projects of similar scale (2,000+ mailboxes)
controlFields.MQ-006: UK-registered company or UK subsidiary with UK-based delivery team
controlFields.MQ-007: Financial stability (3 years audited accounts, positive net assets)
controlFields.MQ-009: All key personnel BPSS clearable (UK nationals or residents with right to work)
controlFields.MQ-011: Proposal follows required format (Annexes A-F as specified in SOW)
controlFields.MQ-012: All required sections completed (no blank sections)
controlFields.MQ-013: Cost proposal submitted separately from technical proposal
controlFields.MQ-014: Key personnel CVs included (Project Manager, Technical Lead, Security Lead)
controlFields.MQ-015: Three client references provided with contact details
controlFields.MQ-016: Signed acceptance of Cabinet Office General Terms and Conditions
controlFields.MQ-017: Signed Data Processing Agreement (DPA) and GDPR compliance declaration
controlFields.Excellent (90-100%): Exceeds expectations; innovative approach; demonstrates deep M365 migration expertise; minimal risks; clearly meets all requirements
controlFields.Good (75-89%): Meets all expectations; sound methodology; minor concerns or areas requiring clarification
controlFields.Adequate (60-74%): Meets most expectations; workable approach; some gaps or concerns requiring discussion
controlFields.Weak (40-59%): Meets minimum expectations; significant concerns; substantial gaps or unproven methodology
controlFields.Unacceptable (0-39%): Does not meet expectations; major flaws; unworkable approach; critical requirements not addressed

ARC-001-SOW-v1.0.title: Statement of Work (SOW): Exchange Online Migration to Microsoft 365

controlFields.Document Type: Procurement - Statement of Work / Request for Proposal (RFP)
controlFields.Distribution: Qualified Vendors, Procurement Team, Architecture Team
controlFields.Current State Assessment: Exchange 2016 environment documentation (servers, mailbox distribution, sizes, permissions, transport rules)
controlFields.High-Level Design (HLD): Architecture overview (C4 Context, Container diagrams), M365 tenant config, hybrid identity design, migration approach
controlFields.Detailed Design (DLD): Component specifications (Azure AD Connect, Conditional Access, sensitivity labels, DLP, Defender, retention policies), migration plan
controlFields.Security Design: Threat model (NCSC guidance), security controls mapped to NCSC Cloud Security Principles, compliance matrix (GDPR, Gov Sec Classifications)
controlFields.Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA) Support: PIA documentation support, lawful basis analysis, data flow diagrams
controlFields.Migration Plan: Phased migration schedule (pilot, Phase 1-3), batch definitions, rollback procedures, validation plan
controlFields.Azure AD Connect Configuration: Hybrid identity deployed (3,500 users synced), password hash sync enabled, SSO tested
controlFields.Exchange Hybrid Configuration: Hybrid coexistence (on-prem + cloud), free/busy federation, mailbox move capability
controlFields.Conditional Access Policies: 5 policies (MFA all users, block legacy auth, device compliance, geofencing, high-risk controls)
controlFields.Sensitivity Labels & DLP: OFFICIAL/OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE labels, auto-labeling rules, DLP policies (block external OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE)
controlFields.Defender for Office 365: Safe Links, Safe Attachments, anti-phishing, anti-impersonation policies
controlFields.Retention Policies: Retention labels (Transitory 1yr, Financial 7yr, Policy Papers 20yr), auto-application rules
controlFields.Intune Device Compliance: Device compliance policies (PIN, OS version, jailbreak detection), Conditional Access enforcement
controlFields.Unified Audit Log & Sentinel: UAL enabled (7-year retention), Sentinel integration (Event Hub), alerting rules
controlFields.M365 Configuration Baseline: M365DSC export of tenant configuration (IaC baseline for change control and DR)
controlFields.Pilot Migration (100 users): Finance directorate, IT volunteers, M365 Champions migrated and validated
controlFields.Phase 1 Migration (1,200 users): Corporate Services, Digital & Technology, Policy & Strategy migrated
controlFields.Phase 2 Migration (1,200 users): Economic & Domestic Affairs, European & Global Affairs, Cabinet Secretariat migrated
controlFields.Phase 3 Migration (1,000 users + execs): Propriety & Constitution, Executive team, Ministerial offices migrated
controlFields.Migration Validation Reports: Per-batch validation: item count match, folder structure, calendar accuracy, permissions, performance metrics
controlFields.Change Management Plan: ADKAR model, stakeholder engagement, communication plan, resistance management
controlFields.M365 Champions Network: 50+ champions recruited, trained, and equipped for peer support
controlFields.Training Materials: eLearning modules (Outlook Web App, Outlook mobile, Outlook desktop), quick reference guides, video tutorials
controlFields.Training Delivery: Role-based training sessions (end users, administrators, executives)
controlFields.Service Desk Knowledge Base: Knowledge articles (Outlook access, password reset, mobile setup, troubleshooting), escalation procedures
controlFields.User Communications: Email campaigns, intranet announcements, town halls, posters (pre-migration, cutover notifications, post-migration tips)
controlFields.Architecture Documentation: C4 model (Context, Container, Component), logical architecture, network diagram, data flow diagrams
controlFields.Administrator Guides: Exchange Online Admin Center, PowerShell cmdlets, mailbox management, security policy admin, troubleshooting
controlFields.Operational Runbooks: Incident response (mailbox compromise, phishing, mail flow failure), eDiscovery (FOI requests, legal hold), user support (password reset, access issues)
controlFields.User Manuals: Outlook Web App user guide, Outlook mobile guide, Outlook desktop guide, FAQs
controlFields.Configuration Baseline (M365DSC): Infrastructure-as-Code export of M365 tenant configuration (Conditional Access, DLP, Defender, retention policies)
controlFields.Knowledge Transfer Sessions: Architecture walkthrough, operations training (monitoring, incident response), security training (DLP, Defender, audit logs)
controlFields.Post-Implementation Review: Lessons learned, benefits realization analysis, recommendations for ongoing optimization
controlFields.Pilot Test Results: Pilot migration validation (item counts, performance, security, user feedback)
controlFields.UAT Results: User acceptance testing after each phase (functionality, performance, usability)
controlFields.Performance Test Results: Email delivery latency, OWA page load time, migration throughput
controlFields.Security Test Results: Conditional Access testing, DLP testing, MFA enforcement, penetration test (NCSC CHECK)
controlFields.Accessibility Test Results: WCAG 2.2 AA compliance (OWA, training materials, documentation)
controlFields.DR Test Results: UK West region failover test (RTO <4 hours, RPO <15 minutes)
controlFields.Planning & Design: Current state assessment, HLD, DLD, security design, PIA support
controlFields.M365 Configuration: Azure AD Connect, Conditional Access, Purview, Defender, Intune, Sentinel, M365DSC baseline
controlFields.Migration Execution: Pilot + Phase 1-3 migration (3,500 mailboxes), validation, rollback procedures
controlFields.Training & Change Management: Change plan, Champions network, training materials, delivery, service desk prep
controlFields.Documentation & Knowledge Transfer: Architecture docs, admin guides, runbooks, user manuals, KT sessions
controlFields.Testing: Pilot testing, UAT, performance testing, security testing (NCSC CHECK pen test), accessibility testing, DR testing
controlFields.Project Management: Project manager, reporting, governance, RAID management
controlFields.Third-Party Costs: NCSC CHECK pen test, accessibility audit, travel expenses (if applicable)
controlFields.L2 Support: M365 configuration support, mailbox management, security policy tuning
controlFields.L3 Support: Architecture advisory, complex troubleshooting, escalations from Cabinet Office IT
controlFields.Retained Services: Ad-hoc consulting (e.g., new features, policy changes), X hours/month included

ARC-001-DIAG-002-v1.0.title: Architecture Diagram: M365 Identity and Authentication Flows

controlFields.Flow 1: User Authentication with Zero Tr: Show complete authentication journey with MFA, Conditional Access evaluation (5 policies), and token issuance
controlFields.Flow 2: Hybrid Identity Sync: Show Azure AD Connect synchronization (30-min cycle), password hash sync (PHS), user provisioning, license assignment, and offboarding
controlFields.Flow 3: Admin Access with PIM: Show Privileged Identity Management (PIM) just-in-time admin access with approval workflow, 8-hour activation, and automatic deactivation
controlFields.Flow 4: Device Compliance for Mobile: Show Intune enrollment, device compliance evaluation (PIN, OS version, jailbreak detection, encryption), and Mobile Application Management (MAM) policies
controlFields.Session Cookie: 8 hours continuous use OR 30 min inactivity
controlFields.OWA (Outlook Web App): 8 hours continuous use OR 30 min inactivity
controlFields.Outlook Desktop (cached mode): Token refresh every 1 hour (up to 90 days)
controlFields.Outlook Mobile: Token refresh every 1 hour (up to 90 days)
controlFields.Admin Portal (M365 Admin Center): 8 hours continuous use OR 30 min inactivity
controlFields.Principle 10: Identity and Authenticatio: Azure AD OAuth 2.0, MFA (Authenticator, FIDO2), passwordless roadmap
controlFields.Principle 12: Secure Service Administrat: Privileged Identity Management (PIM), no standing admin privileges
controlFields.Principle 13: Audit Information for User: Unified Audit Log (7-year retention), all sign-ins and privileged actions logged
controlFields.TCoP 6: Make things secure: Zero Trust (5 Conditional Access policies: MFA, device, location, legacy auth, risk)
controlFields.TCoP 7: Make privacy integral: Audit logging (who, what, when, where, why), PII minimization (password hashes only, not plaintext)
